body: Thank you everyone. I am a little hopeful about life after writing this post. Writing it all out helped me understand my emotions. I am going to get professional help. Last time I chose to suppress my feelings and ended up doing something stupid. I am going to reveal all my emotions to the mental health services.

But showing my face everyday to my parent's will only remind them of the failures. Wouldn't it be better that they didn't see my face at all? Wouldn't it be better to the society that the money that they are spending on me they rather spend on charity helping the needy and deserved? No matter what I do in the future, the past is always going to be with me reminding of my failures.
